$comment: Source of truth for .claude-plugin/marketplace.json validation; edit these files directly. Layout: marketplace.schema.json (file envelope), plugin-entry.schema.json (one plugin), common.schema.json (shared primitives), sources/ (plugin source forms), components/ (plugin component declarations) and one file each for dependency, relevance, user-config and channel. Cross-file $ref are relative and each `$id` is the file's path relative to this directory. Built from the official Claude Code docs (plugin-marketplaces, plugins-reference, plugin-dependencies, plugin-relevance, hooks, mcp) and verified against `claude plugin validate --strict` 2.1.281 on 2026-09-24. Not the SchemaStore schema: fields are docs-derived; undocumented-but-accepted fields carry x-undocumented. additionalProperties:false is used where the CLI warns on unknown keys (root, metadata, plugin entries, relevance, experimental, userConfig options, LSP servers, monitors, channels) and true where it accepts them silently (owner, author, source objects, dependency objects, hook handlers, MCP server configs). Not expressible in JSON Schema and left to the CLI: unique plugin names, renames chain resolution, entry.version vs plugin.json cross-check, existence of source directories, name impersonation heuristics, unique monitor names, options default membership, sha256 of archives.
title: Claude Code plugin marketplace (.claude-plugin/marketplace.json)
description: Catalog of plugins that Claude Code can install with /plugin install <plugin>@<marketplace>. Lives at .claude-plugin/marketplace.json in the marketplace repository root, or is served as a direct URL to the file.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URL for editor autocomplete; Claude Code ignores it at load time.

name.description: Marketplace identifier (kebab-case recommended). Public-facing: /plugin install <plugin>@<name>. One marketplace per name per user. npm, pip, uv, cargo, github, gh (any casing) are hard errors in `claude plugin validate`. A name that impersonates an official marketplace (heuristic; the docs give official-claude-plugins and anthropic-plugins-v2 as examples) is a hard error too. The 17 names in x-reserved-official-names are reserved for Anthropic per the docs, but `claude plugin validate` does NOT reject them (oracle-verified on 2.1.281, re-checked on 2.1.310 with claude-plugins-official and healthcare) — enforcement happens only when the marketplace is actually registered (`/plugin marketplace add`), which this schema cannot exercise offline. Likewise 'org', 'org-provisioned' and 'unknown' are only a Claude-Desktop-sync warning, not a validate error. A name containing `..` fails `claude plugin validate`.
name.x-not-enforced-by: claude plugin validate 2.1.310 (offline); docs say Claude Code re-checks reserved names on every marketplace load

owner.description: Marketplace maintainer information (unknown keys are accepted silently by the CLI).

name.description: Name of the maintainer or team.

url.description: Website, GitHub profile or organization URL.

plugins.description: List of available plugins. Plugin names must be unique (case-sensitive) within the marketplace. An empty list is a validator warning.

description.description: Brief marketplace description (also accepted under metadata for backward compatibility). Missing description is a validator warning.

version.description: Marketplace manifest version (also accepted under metadata for backward compatibility).

metadata.description: Optional marketplace metadata. Unknown keys are validator warnings.

pluginRoot.description: Directory that bare plugin source names resolve under (v2.1.239+). Must itself be a relative path inside the marketplace.

description.description: Marketplace description (backward-compatible spelling of the top-level field).

version.description: Marketplace version (backward-compatible spelling of the top-level field).

allowCrossMarketplaceDependenciesOn.description: Other marketplaces that plugins in this marketplace may depend on; dependencies from an unlisted marketplace are blocked at install. Only the root marketplace's list is consulted (no transitive trust).

renames.description: Map from a former plugin name to its current name, or to null if the plugin was removed (v2.1.193+). Treat as append-only history; chains are followed. Every chain must end at null or a name listed in plugins (cycles and dangling targets are errors; not expressible in JSON Schema).

forceRemoveDeletedPlugins.description: When true, plugins removed from this marketplace are automatically uninstalled and flagged for users.
forceRemoveDeletedPlugins.x-note: In the SchemaStore baseline; accepted by CLI 2.1.281 without warning; the binary references it in delisted-plugin enforcement. Absent from every current docs page and the changelog.
